lines.trans: Boss, you probably did not know Xiaogu has been a fan of Rong Silun for quite a while.
She certainly has plenty of idols and is not picky.
Excuse me, everyone—I am late.
No problem at all—if we do not wait for a superstar, who would we wait for?
You know I am never late for work; today is truly the very first time.
It really is fine; waiting a little is routine in our line of work.
Knowing I overslept, why did you not give me a wake-up reminder?
Even making a phone call or sending a text message would have helped.
I am sorry—this one was my fault.
Even I slip up once in a while, so do not be upset; it will not happen again.
Excuse me, let me head over to the dressing room.
Alright, I will walk her over to the dressing room.
